title: Freya and the Current
author: Ansel Quintana
blurb: Elodie Dravenmoor, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
